schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: tsc 6 and typescript-eslint's parser peer <6.1.0; Oxlint's type-aware engine bundles its own TS 7

Stay on the Node 26 LTS line until the next LTS move is made on purpose. Covers every Node version pin: the docker `node` image (Dockerfile), `.node-version` and `actions/setup-node`'s `node-version:` (node-version datasource, depName `node`).
Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once the required checks pass.
Majors always wait for a human.
The pinned toolchain always waits for a human.

expo, react-native and posthog-react-native move together with the Expo SDK; a minor or major waits for a person who runs `npx expo install --check` and reads the SDK's notes. After the automerge rule, which it overrides.

@posthog/cli always waits for a person, who updates every hash in scripts/posthog-cli.sha256 in the same PR. No CI job runs the hash check, so an automerged bump would fail the next build that uploads source maps. After the automerge rule, which it overrides.
